title: 臭花倒數
subject: Taipei botanical garden staff and a growing crowd waiting four nights for a giant corpse flower (titan arum) to open, everyone holding their noses and refusing to go home
caption: Chinese folk-melody phonk, Douyin drift-phonk style built on a pentatonic folk tune. Ringing distorted cowbell playing the folk melody, a buzzing hulusi riff answering it, heavily saturated 808 bass slides, fast Memphis-style hi-hats and rimshots, crisp handclaps. Clipped, saturated low end with a dry upfront vocal. Bright female lead with a folk-singer timbre, half-chanted, a crew of friends shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, A minor. Giddy, mock-heroic and silly. No trap rap verses, no autotune, no EDM supersaw drop, no ballad piano, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - cowbell folk melody, hulusi answers, 808 slides in]

[Verse 1]
溫室門口排到第三根路燈
園丁阿伯說今晚應該會開
它憋了七年只為開兩天
我們捏著鼻子還在等

[Pre-Chorus]
數到三 先別走
風一吹 誰先吐

[Chorus]
臭花倒數 臭花倒數
三 二 一 它還是沒動
口罩戴兩層 也擋不住
臭到整條南海路

[Verse 2]
第四晚帶了板凳和鹹酥雞
隔壁小孩把爸爸當枕頭
凌晨兩點葉片抖了一下
全場安靜像在等放榜

[Pre-Chorus]
數到三 別眨眼
味道 比花先到

[Chorus]
臭花倒數 臭花倒數
三 二 一 它真的打開
死老鼠加上臭襪子
我們一邊叫一邊拍

[Outro - cowbell and claps, crew shouts, 808 cuts out]
下一次 再等七年
我還來
